title: perl-dap debug adapter configuration
description: Debug configuration for the EffortlessMetrics perl-dap adapter. The launch request requires an explicit program; attach is not supported by this extension yet. Unknown forward-compatible keys are preserved by pass-through.

request.description: Only `launch` is supported; `attach` is rejected with a typed error.

program.description: Path to the Perl program to debug.

args.description: Arguments passed to the Perl program.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debug session.

env.description: Environment variables for the debug session.
